signals_info.description: Boolean state indicating loss of effective traction; 0 means effective traction is available.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At the current time or at some future time, traction loss shall equal 0.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在当前或未来某个时刻，牵引力丧失状态应为 0。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The vehicle shall have effective traction now or at some later time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 车辆应在当前或之后某个时刻具备有效牵引力。
